title: ICT in Business and Society: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Distinguish between Information technology and information technology infrastructure.
Describe the relevance of enterprise software application in an organizational set up.
Examine how an organization can benefit from a supply management systems.
Describe the 3 elements of an organization.
Evaluate the factors you would consider when planning for a new information system.
f) Describe the 3 legal elements of intellectual property.
Discuss information technology and ways in which it has impacted on the society
Analyze the key features of Management Information Systems.
